level: K-67 Vertical Slice — Elevator Descent & Core Access
notes: CONNECTIONS: Entrance from [Level 1: Hangar Intake Elevator Shaft], Exit to [Level 3: Research Sub-Level].
CAMERA: fixed oblique 55deg / orthographic, no rotation.

GATING: Shaft descent requires bypassing dead elevator controls via maintenance ladder and manual winch. Lower sub-level airlock requires dual biometric authorization (Kael's remote relay + Laura's Sec-1 Badge).

STORY: Laura descends deeper into the station structure following Kael's live feed. The architecture shifts from industrial hangar to decaying, high-pressure research conduits. Director Miller's broadcasts become frantic, hinting at an autonomous facility lockdown protocol known as 'The Core Aegis'.

beats.label: Descent entry — shaft overview
beats.objective: Drop through the shaft entry and reach the sub-level control booth.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: You're in the vertical maintenance chute. Watch your footing—gravity dampeners on this tier are failing.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: The elevator car is jammed halfway down. You'll need to drop onto the maintenance ladder and clear the blockage manually.

beats.label: Control booth — winching the cage
beats.objective: Activate the emergency winch in the control booth to clear the shaft.

dialogue.speaker: laura
dialogue.name: LAURA
dialogue.text: Winch is rusted solid. Putting my weight into it.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: That's it, crank it! Freeing that cage will drop the debris clear of the lower research airlock.

dialogue.speaker: miller
dialogue.name: DIRECTOR MILLER
dialogue.text: Associate Laura. You are tampering with core structural mechanisms. Cease immediately.

dialogue.speaker: miller
dialogue.name: DIRECTOR MILLER
dialogue.text: The sub-level houses specimens you are not cleared to perceive. Turn back.

beats.label: Airlock biometrics — opening research sub-level
beats.objective: Authenticate with your Sec-1 Badge and Kael's relay to open the research antechamber.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: I'm routing my remote handshake into the terminal now. Swipe your badge simultaneously.

dialogue.speaker: laura
dialogue.name: LAURA
dialogue.text: The door's parting. What's down there, Kael?

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: Answers. Or the bottom of the pit. Let's move.
